content: Juda nat nɨmba kat kwulatɨgandi? Mbangɨ pɨtnja vak apma vatna? Kavle vat ana ndɨ.

God Juda kat apma vat yindɨ. Ndɨnai waa nyaangɨt ndi kat kwilaa mbutndɨ. Ndina nat nɨmba God waa nyaangɨk kat ndina mbangɨ kɨlɨpangɨ yindɨ. Ndɨnai waa nyaangɨtmba ana yetɨndi. Wungi kat tɨga God ndɨnai waa apma vat yigiyowun waa nyaangɨtmba yigiyandɨ? E? Ana yigiyandɨ?

Yigiyandɨ luwa. Nat nɨmba woseka walɨgandi. God wupma kai. Yigiyowun wandeyan yigiyandɨ luwa. Tamba God waa nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutndi. Nat nɨmba God kat wagalagiyandi. God woseka walɨgandɨ? E? Woseka ana walɨgandɨ waa vɨgiyandi, waa pɨlɨwutndi.

Nat nɨmba kavle vak walɨgandi. God waa nyaangɨtmba yetɨlapman yineyan wovuna walɨgandi. Kavle vat yetɨna vak vɨga God wungi kavle vapmba ana yetɨlɨgandɨ waa waigandi. Ndɨ apma nyana waigandi. Nɨnai yetɨga kavle vak kat vɨlaa Godna sɨ kwusogiyandi. Wungi kat tɨga manda kat sɨgiyandɨ nɨna kavle vak kat waa kavle vat walɨgandi.

Wan nyaangɨt kavle nyaangɨtna. God wupma ana lɨgandɨ. God kavle vat yilɨga nɨmb kat sɨndey yat ndɨna maawut ana tɨvɨlzɨgandɨ. Maawut tɨvɨlɨga nyan tɨndeyan ana vapmba yigumba kotgiyandɨ ndinyangu kat. Ana inaka lɨgandɨ.
Nɨna kavle vat ndɨna sɨ kwusondeyan nɨn kat ana sɨgiyandɨ. Wungi kat tɨga ndɨna sɨ kwusovat kavle vat mɨna yetɨgiyanɨn waa kavle vat walɨgandi. Wupma kai.

Godna sɨ kwusovat kavle vapmba yetɨ nɨn kat God walɨgandɨ waa kavle vak walɨgandi. Ana nglaatndɨ. Wan nyaangɨt ngumbulɨga nɨmba kat God ndi kat sɨgiyandɨ. Sɨmblan ana sɨgiyandɨ. Nat nɨmba walɨgandi. Pol wan nyaangɨt mbutɨgandɨ. Woseka walɨgandi. Wan nyaangɨt ana mbutɨgowun.
NDINYANGU AYWAA KAVLE VAT MƗNA YETƗLƗGANDI

Nɨn Juda apma vat tɨganɨn. Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba kavle vat tɨgandi waa yelavɨtɨgangwuk? Waa ngwuk kat wagalawun. Kai. Wan apma vat ana ndɨ. Juda Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba kat aywaa wan kavle vat ndi kat vɨga lɨgandɨ.
Tamba God waa nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutndi. Apma vat yetɨlɨga nɨmba kai. Kwo lɨgandi.
God yetɨlɨga vak ana vɨlɨgandi. Vɨvak kat kai walɨgandi.
God kat kwagalalaa aywaa kavle vapmba yetɨlɨgandi. Apma vat yetɨlɨga nɨmba kai.
Ndinai waa nyaangɨt ndinyangu kat vatnyavla lɨgandɨ. Ndina kwundimba woseka walɨgandi. Ndinai waa nyaangɨt mbai vla ndu nyan kat sɨlɨgandɨ.
Ndinyangu kat kavle nyaangɨt mɨna ngambulɨndi.
Kao nambwiya ndi. Kwiyatapman ndu sɨlɨndi.
Kɨta kava yɨnjeyan wan ngepma vat tɨgiyandɨ.
Ngwaama nyan tɨvak kat kai walɨndi.
God kat ana yelavɨka lɨndi.

Wungi kat tɨga God ngepma ngepmamba lɨga nɨmba kat nɨma vat yigiyandɨ. God waa lo wuka lɨga nɨmba vɨlɨgandi. O! Nɨn kavle vat mɨna yetɨlɨganɨn waa vɨlɨgandi aywaa. Wutndi maa God walɨgandɨ. Wunai waa nyaangɨpmba ana yetɨlɨgangwuk. God waa nyaangɨt wuka yetɨlɨnangat God nɨn kat wunai lɨga vla lɨgangwuk ana waigandɨ. Manda kat. Nɨn ndɨnai waa nyaangɨpmba ana inaka yetɨlɨganɨn. Ndɨnai waa nyaangɨt kavle vat yetɨlɨnangat nɨn kat sɨmagalɨgandɨ.
GOD NƗN KAT WUNAI LƗGA VLA LƗGANGWUK WAA WAGIYAA VAK

Nat vapmba God nɨn kat wunai lɨga vla lɨgangwuk waa waigandɨ. Wan vak God waa nyaangɨt kwundimba mbuka pɨlɨwutɨga nɨmbagwi nat nɨmbo wutaa pɨlɨwutndi tamba. Jisas Kraist kwuta njɨvwa nɨna lak yaandɨ waneyan God nɨn kat wunai lɨga vwa lɨgangwuk waigandɨ. Juda walɨnja nɨmba Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba aywaa wan vapmba God ndi kat klagiyandɨ.
Aywaa kavle kat mɨna yetɨlɨndi. God yetɨga vapmba yetɨvak yilavindi.
Wungi kat tɨga God ndinyangu kat aywaa awagapma wandɨ. Wuna nyan ngwuk kat tɨga wun kat wenga kwindɨ. Wun kat wenga kwindangat ngwuk kat wunai lɨga vla lɨgangwuk waigowun waa wandɨ God.

God Jisas kat ay wandɨ maa nɨna kavle vak aywaa Jisas Kraist yiga klandɨ. Klandɨ maa God ndɨ kat sɨndɨ, kiyandɨ. Ndɨ kat tamba sandɨ. Nɨn kat ana sɨgiyandɨ. God nɨn kat tɨga Jisas kat sɨnda kat nɨna mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagndeyan God nɨn kat ana sɨgiyandɨ. God kavle yetɨna vak kat sɨgiyaa vak ana kwagalandɨ. Tamba sɨndɨ. Tamba la nɨmba ndina kavle vat yetɨnja vak kat ndi kat ana sɨndɨ. Manda kat. Ngɨni wuna nyan kat ndi kat tɨga sɨgiywoun waa walaa ndi kat ana sɨndɨ.

Mbambala wungi vat sɨgak. God kavle yetɨlɨna vak kat sɨgiyaa vak ana kwagalalɨgandɨ. God nɨn kat tɨga Jisas kat sɨndangat nɨna mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagandeyan God nɨn kat wuani lɨga vla lɨgqangwuk waigandɨ. Ana sɨgiyandɨ.

Kɨta nyan God kat ana apma waigandɨ. Apma vat tɨga lomba tɨwangat vɨlaa apma vat wun kat yɨmɨn waa ana waigandɨ. Manda kat. Nɨna njɨvwa vɨga God nɨn kat ana kwunatndɨ. Jisas kwuta njɨvwa kat nɨna mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagandeyan God nɨn kat kwunakiyandɨ.
Jisas kwutaa njɨvwa kat nɨna mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagandeyan God nɨn kat waigandɨ. Wunai lɨga vla lɨgangwuk waa waigandɨ. Nɨna apma njɨvwa vɨlaga nan kwunakiyandɨ. Vɨlɨganɨn.

God kan vapmba Juda kat mɨna kwunakiyandɨ? Kai Juda kat nat nɨmba Juda ana ndi ndi kat aywaa kan vapmba yilɨgandɨ. Juda kat Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba kat kɨta vapmba. Wunai waa nyaangɨk kat ndina mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagndeyan God ndi kat wagandɨ. Wunai lɨga vla lɨgangwuk waa God waigandɨ.
Apma vak God waa lomba yetɨlɨna vak ana vɨlɨgandɨ? Kai vɨlɨgandɨ. Ndɨna nyan kwutaa njɨvwa kat nɨna mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagandangat apma vat God waa lomba yetɨgiyanɨn.
